facts.text: Northern Arizona University guarantees admission to all students who have finished their junior year and are on track to graduate with a core GPA of at least 2.5 on a 4.0 scale.

sources.title: Steps to apply: first-year student | NAU
sources.quote: We offer guaranteed admission to all students who've completed their junior year and are on track to graduate with a core GPA of 2.5+ (4.0 scale).
